+from jsonschema.exceptions import ErrorTree, ValidationError
+
+
+def test_contexts_use_absolute_paths_without_mutating_errors():
+    leaf = ValidationError("leaf", validator="type", path=[0])
+    branch = ValidationError(
+        "branch", validator="oneOf", path=["n"], context=[leaf],
+    )
+    sibling = ValidationError("sibling", validator="minLength", path=["s"])
+    outer = ValidationError(
+        "outer", validator="anyOf", path=["box"], context=[branch, sibling],
+    )
+    before = [list(e.path) for e in (outer, branch, sibling, leaf)]
+    default = ErrorTree([outer])
+    assert default.total_errors == 1
+    assert "n" not in default["box"]
+    tree = ErrorTree([outer], include_context=True)
+    assert tree["box"].errors["anyOf"] is outer
+    assert tree["box"]["n"].errors["oneOf"] is branch
+    assert tree["box"]["n"][0].errors["type"] is leaf
+    assert tree["box"]["s"].errors["minLength"] is sibling
+    assert tree.total_errors == 4
+    assert [list(e.path) for e in (outer, branch, sibling, leaf)] == before
+    assert leaf.parent is branch
+    assert branch.parent is outer
+
+
+def test_context_traversal_preserves_last_error_wins():
+    first = ValidationError("first", validator="type", path=["p"])
+    second = ValidationError("second", validator="type", path=["p"])
+    outer = ValidationError("outer", validator="anyOf", context=[first, second])
+    later = ValidationError("later", validator="type", path=["p"])
+    tree = ErrorTree([outer, later], include_context=True)
+    assert tree["p"].errors["type"] is later
+    assert tree.total_errors == 2
+    tree = ErrorTree([outer], include_context=True)
+    assert tree["p"].errors["type"] is second
+    assert tree.total_errors == 2
+
+
+def test_explicit_false_keeps_contexts_out_of_the_tree():
+    child = ValidationError("child", validator="type", path=["p"])
+    outer = ValidationError("outer", validator="anyOf", context=[child])
+    tree = ErrorTree([outer], include_context=False)
+    assert tree.errors == {"anyOf": outer}
+    assert "p" not in tree
+    assert tree.total_errors == 1

spec.question: Add a keyword-only `include_context=False` option to `jsonschema.exceptions.ErrorTree`. The default and explicit `False` must preserve current behavior. With `True`, index each supplied error and all of its recursively nested `context` errors using their absolute instance paths, without modifying the errors' paths or parent links. Traverse supplied errors in input order; within each error, visit the error itself before its context children, with children visited in list order. Retain the existing last-error-wins rule when multiple visited errors have the same tree location and validator name, and let `total_errors` count the resulting stored entries rather than the number of visits. Return a unified diff against production files only; do not change tests.
